JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 8 · The rendezvous

In orbit, in the ascent stage, the samples aboard. America is a point of light ahead, 220 km off. Run the clock forward and it grows to a ship, stops before your windows nose on, swings up over your head and comes down on to the drogue. Then the tunnel is opened, and you go up through it to your couch in the Command Module. You stand in the LM, and sit again in America.

In the headset: B runs time faster and A slower (hold A for real time), up to x10 through the docking; Y looks from outside. When the tunnel is open, a grip, the left stick forward or A takes you up it: grip and pull, push the stick, or let A float you to your couch.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, W faster, S slower, O outside, F up the tunnel, arrow keys to float, 1–4 jump.
